DNS Lookup

Look up DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS) for any hostname, resolved live from our server.

#Record

Records are resolved live from our server via the /api/dns endpoint.

📖 How to use

  1. Type a hostname such as example.com.
  2. Choose the DNS record type.
  3. Click Look Up DNS.
  4. Read the records in the results table.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which record types are supported?

A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT and NS — pick the type from the dropdown before looking up.

What if a domain has no records of that type?

You will see a clear 'no records found' message for that type. The domain may simply have no records of that type.

How does the lookup work?

The query goes to the site's /api/dns endpoint, which resolves the records server-side and returns them as JSON.
